project_info.theme: High-energy Ultimate Sup flash-sale poster with a free-gift threshold
project_info.color_palette: Ultimate Sup Yellow, Near Black, Deep Olive Gold, White, Warm Gold Confetti

main_subject.detail: A square ecommerce sale poster with an oversized {{EVENT_MARK}} on the left, an active athlete cutout in the lower left, a ticket-shaped free-gift card in the upper right, and a dense lineup of supplement packshots across the lower right.
main_subject.style: Bold sports-retail compositing, high contrast black-and-yellow campaign design, crisp cutout packshots

composition_elements.text: Use {{EVENT_MARK}}, {{GIFT_HEADLINE}}, {{GIFT_SUBLINE}}, {{SPEND_THRESHOLD}}, {{DATE_WINDOW}}, and {{CTA}}. Add only approved brand, product, and offer copy.
items: Top Left: REF_BRAND_LOGO above the oversized event mark.
Upper Right: REF_GIFT_ITEMS beside a pale-yellow ticket card tied with a gold ribbon.
Lower Left: REF_ATHLETE_MODEL in an energetic sport pose, pointing toward the offer.
Lower Right: REF_PRODUCT_LINEUP arranged in two staggered rows on a yellow plinth.
Bottom: A yellow date-and-CTA strip with a white rounded CTA button.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Gold confetti, clean packshot cutouts, subtle dark geometric panels, strong yellow visual hierarchy

technical_specs.render_style: High fidelity sports-supplement ecommerce poster with composited product packshots

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: Create a square Ultimate Sup flash-sale poster. Preserve the fixed black-and-yellow diagonal composition: oversized {{EVENT_MARK}} left, active REF_ATHLETE_MODEL lower left, pale-yellow ribbon ticket upper right for {{GIFT_HEADLINE}} and {{SPEND_THRESHOLD}}, approved REF_PRODUCT_LINEUP on a yellow plinth lower right, and a bottom yellow strip with {{DATE_WINDOW}} plus {{CTA}}. Use REF_BRAND_LOGO and keep all pack labels accurate. High contrast sports-retail compositing, crisp cutouts, warm gold confetti, 1200 x 1200.
prompt.negative_prompt: unapproved logo, wrong product packaging, unreadable offer text, distorted athlete anatomy, missing ticket, low contrast, cluttered layout, watermark, cropped products

assets.name: Original sale composition
assets.usage: Preserve the four-zone diagonal layout and bottom CTA strip.

assets.name: Approved Ultimate Sup logo
assets.usage: Replace logo only; retain upper-left placement.

assets.name: Approved athlete/model cutout
assets.usage: Replace athlete while preserving lower-left pointing pose and safe crop.

assets.name: Campaign SKU packshots
assets.usage: Replace all SKU packshots; preserve two-row lower-right lineup.

assets.name: Gift packshots
assets.usage: Place inside or beside the ticket card without obscuring offer text.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach REF_LAYOUT, REF_BRAND_LOGO, REF_PRODUCT_LINEUP, and any selected model/gift assets. Build typography in post-production when exact campaign text is required.

substitutable_fields.replacement_rule: Use the approved campaign event name or date.
Use only current approved SGD terms.
Replace with active campaign timing and CTA.
